subject: Plan upgrade / downgrade clarity + bundle pricing for Medigroup
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@medigroup.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medigroup.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Packaging options and upgrade path questions (RFP attached)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the product overview last week. Our procurement and platform teams reviewed the notes and the attached RFP (see Medigroup_RFP_v2.pdf). A few clarification asks before we move to commercial:

- We need a clear upgrade path: if we start on hosted API and later move to Dedicated reserved pools, what is the migration window and are there one-time migration fees?
- For Dedicated, what are the typical bundling options (seat-based vs throughput buckets)? Can we mix a small reserved pool with burst hosted capacity?
- Discounts: Medigroup is asking for a supplier discount for a 12-month commitment. What levers do you have (commit length, usage minimums, onboarding credits)?
- Downgrade protections: if usage falls below commit levels, how are credits/proration handled?

We’d like to share this with engineering tomorrow. Can you provide a short matrix (upgrade path, expected lead times, pricing levers) and an initial commercial pulse?

Appreciate it —
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Procurement
MediGroup

Attachment: Medigroup_RFP_v2.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medigroup.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging options and upgrade path questions (RFP attached)

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the RFP and the clear list. Quick summary below; I can convert this into a one-page matrix for engineering.

1) Migration path (Hosted -> Dedicated):
- Typical timeline: 3–6 weeks from commercial sign (provisioning + model onboarding + smoke tests).
- One-time migration fee: we usually waive the engineering migration fee for a 12-month committed Dedicated contract; otherwise there’s a modest onboarding charge (USD 15k).
- Hybrid option: you can run a small Dedicated reserved pool (e.g., 2 GPUs) plus hosted burst for spikes — routing and autoscaling handled by our control plane.

2) Bundles and billing constructs:
- Seat-based: fixed monthly seats + per-token overage. Best if you have predictable user seats.
- Throughput buckets (reserved): capacity-based commits priced by GPU-hour equivalent and effective for high-throughput inference.
- Combo: Reserved pool + metered hosted bursts (recommended for early-stage Dedicated migrations).

3) Discount levers:
- 12-month committed Dedicated = baseline 10% off public list.
- 24-month or >$500k ARR commit = up to 15% + onboarding credit (applied to first invoice).
- Shorter pilots (3–6 months) can get a one-time onboarding credit (we suggested $25k historically) but limited discount on list rates.

4) Downgrade / proration policy:
- If you step down before the commit term, we apply usage credits for unused reserved capacity on a pro rata basis, subject to a rebill for consumed spot/hosted usage. We include a 30-day rollback buffer for the first year of the contract to smooth transitions.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll draft a 1-page matrix and two concrete commercial options: (A) 12-month Dedicated commit (2-GPU pool) with 10% discount + $15k onboarding credit; (B) Hybrid pilot: 3-month hosted pilot with option to convert to Dedicated in 6 weeks, $25k onboarding credit, no up-front commit discount.
- Ben and Lauren are looped for pricing/entitlements approval — Ben, can you confirm we have margin to support option A at 10% for MG?

Samira — can you tell me the target decision date and whether Medigroup needs a PO or contract before provisioning?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(On behalf of Sales)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging options and upgrade path questions (RFP attached)

Karthik —

Thanks for the write-up. Internal stance: we can approve Option A (12-month commit, 10% + $15k onboarding credit) provided the following are met:

- Minimum ARR floor of $200k for the 12-month term (to preserve economics);
- Clear rollback language: 30-day buffer, and any downgrade mid-term converts remaining reserved capacity to a runway credit applied to hosted usage at list rates (no retroactive refunds beyond credit).
- We can offer a one-time migration fee waiver for Managed onboarding but no perpetual waived fees for future migrations.

If Medigroup wants 15% we need a 24-month commit and minimum $500k ARR — escalate to leadership for exceptions.

Lauren — please confirm entitlements (role-based access, SOC logs retention level, and whether the Dedicated pool can be set up in our EU region or must be US-only for Medigroup).

Ben
SVP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@medigroup.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medigroup.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging options and upgrade path questions (RFP attached)

Karthik / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. That gives us the clarity we needed. A few follow-ups from procurement/finance:

- Medigroup prefers the 12-month path if you can confirm the $200k floor and the onboarding credit in writing. That aligns with our FY27 forecast.
- Please add explicit downgrade language to the SOW (we requested a 60-day notice and pro rata credit applied to future hosted consumption). The 30-day buffer is tight for our internal approvals — can you meet 60 days?
- Confirm whether the Dedicated pool will be in US-West (we require data residency in US for now).

Assuming we can get the SOW with those edits, Procurement will prepare a PO. Can someone send the SOW template and your standard amendment language (redlines accepted via DocuSign)?

If we get that today, we can aim to sign next week.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Procurement
MediGroup
